info.author: Loot Tavern

element.name: Amnesiac
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

li.i: Choose one kind of Artisan's Tools

ul.li: Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Bedroll, Book (fiction), Traveler’s Clothes, 22 GP; or (B) 50 GP

description.p: You woke up one day in the city of Luyarnha with no memory of who you were or where you came from. You're almost certain that this place is not your home, but all the memories of your past life are a haze of indistinct shapes and sounds. Faint images, such as a silver lake or a towering mountain, flash through your mind, but they provide no concrete details of your origin. You know only that you must find the truth at any cost.

setters.set: Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, Curious Feat, Insight and Investigation Skills, an Artisan's Tool

element.name: Beast Hunter
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

ul.li: Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Dagger, Flare, Flask, 20 Firearm Bullets, Healer’s Kit, Herbalism Kit, Traveler’s Clothes, 30 GP; or (B) 50 GP

description.p: Growing up, the menacing presence of the Scourge loomed over your life in the city. The beasts terrified you, destroyed your homes, and took away people you loved. Driven by vengeance, fear, or a desire for justice, you chose to become a hunter. The Church, a mentor, or the Radiant Order taught you the ways of the hunt, giving you the knowledge and skills needed to defend your city and yourself. Whether you were once a simple citizen turned protector or a seasoned veteran of the First War hardened by countless battles, you have become an essential line of defense against the darkness.

setters.set: Strength, Dexterity, Wisdom, Grizzled Feat, Athletics and Survival Skills, Herbalism Kit

element.name: Cult Initiate
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

li.i: Choose one kind of Artisan's Tools or Musical Instrument

ul.li: Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Arcane Focus (your choice), art object (worth 10 GP), Artisan’s Tools or Musical Instrument (same as above), Hooded Lantern, Oil (5 flasks), Traveler’s Clothes, 5 GP; or (B) 50 GP.

description.p: Whether through your own choice or a twist of fate, you found yourself part of a clandestine and often misunderstood group of individuals—a cult. This may have been a circle focused on the symbiotic relationship of flesh and nature, a scholastic order obsessed with the cosmos, or followers of a prophecy predicting the apocalypse. However, your faith or circumstances have since changed, leading you to leave the confines of the cult. You might still be an active member, or you may have escaped its influence. Either way, your experiences within the cult and the knowledge you've gained have left a deep impact on your life.

setters.set: Constitution, Wisdom, Charisma, Faithful Feat, Arcana and Persuasion Skills, an Artisan's Tool or Musical Instrument

element.name: Disciple
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

ul.li: Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Book (prayer), Calligrapher’s Supplies, Fine Clothes, Holy Symbol, 5 GP; or (B) 50 GP

description.p: The Radiant Church, a beacon of hope and strength, raised you, training you in the teachings of the Radiant One. As a disciple, you were immersed in the Church's lore, its ideals of benevolence born of resilience and fortitude, and its promise of a prosperous future. You were taught to shine your light into the darkness, to lead the way for others, and to be a pillar of strength in times of adversity. Whether you're an ardent believer, a skeptic questioning your faith, or someone seeking to wield the Church's influence, your time in the Church has undoubtedly shaped your worldview and your identity.

setters.set: Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, Faithful Feat, Persuasion and Religion Skills, Calligrapher’s Supplies

element.name: Inquisitor
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

ul.li: Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Book (prayer), Holy Symbol, Manacles, Torture Tools, Traveler’s Clothes, 3 GP; or (B) 50 GP

description.p: You are a steadfast disciple of the Radiant Church, filled with an unwavering faith and a holy zeal that drives you to root out any threats to the Church and its teachings. Your duty might involve questioning potential heretics, investigating signs of corruption within the Church, or combating the enemies of the faith. You walk a fine line, enforcing the laws of the Church and ensuring the purity of its followers.

setters.set: Strength, Wisdom, Charisma, Faithful Feat, Intimidation and Religion Skills, Torture Tools

element.name: Investigator
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

li.i: Choose one kind of Artisan's Tools related to your investigative methods

ul.li: Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Artisan’s Tools (same as above), Paper (10 sheets), Traveler’s Clothes, 32 GP; or (B) 50 GP

description.p: As an investigator, your life is a ceaseless pursuit of the elusive truth. You are driven by a profound desire to understand the perplexing enigma that is the Scourge, the inscrutable disappearances happening across the city, the veiled cult activities, the covert dealings within the Church, or the aristocrats' clandestine affairs. Regardless of the specifics, you are a seeker of knowledge and truth, using your keen insight and intellect to unravel the mysteries that plague your world. You might be a former scholar, a detective, or just an average citizen who was personally affected by these events, and you won't stop until you reveal the truth.

setters.set: Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, Curious Feat, Insight and Investigation Skills, an Artisan's Tool

element.name: Marked for Death
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

ul.li: Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Dagger, Flare, Paper (50 sheets), Sacrificial Brand Eldritch Carving (Scarified), Traveler’s Clothes, 44 GP; or (B) Sacrificial Brand Eldritch Carving (Scarified), 50 GP

description.p: You once were dead, but the mysterious Blood Moon of Rebirth returned you to life, leaving an indelible Eldritch Carving on your body—the Sacrificial Brand. The mark on your flesh is feared by many, as it is believed to attract the terrible creatures that plague the world. To you, it represents the weight of your past life and the promise that this life will again end violently. Embracing your new life as a symbol of rebirth and sacrifice, you have resolved to use this opportunity, even if it leads to countless brutal struggles.

setters.set: Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Grizzled Feat, Arcana and Survival Skills

element.name: Scion
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

ul.li: Tool Proficiency: Tinker’s Tools; Choose one kind of Artisan's Tools
Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Artisan’s Tools (same as above), Ink, Ink Pen, Paper (50 sheets), Tinker’s Tools, Traveler’s Clothes, 3 GP; or (B) 50 GP

description.p: You are a member of the Scions, a group of brilliant, boundary-pushing scientists working at the fringe of societal norms and scientific understanding. You have seen life breathed into the lifeless, creating living constructs through electrifying science—a practice never seen before. As a member of the Scions, the inventions and creations of your group have earned favor among the city's higher-ups. Yet these same marvels have also given delusions of grandeur to those who wrestle with the godlike power of creation at their fingertips.

setters.set: Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Curious Feat, Arcana and Investigation Skills, Tinker’s Tools and an Artisan's Tool

element.name: Worthless Husk
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

ul.li: Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Dagger, sewer grate key, Traveler’s Clothes, 5 GP; or (B) 10 GP

description.p: You were born into a world that saw you as utterly worthless, a waste of skin. Deemed talentless and devoid of potential, you were cast aside by those around you. As a worthless husk, you have learned to navigate the treacherous environment of the city, using your wits and endurance to survive. Given the chance to grow—a chance which you may never get—you could prove that even the most overlooked souls can make a difference in this twisted world.

setters.set: Dexterity, Constitution, Wisdom, Worthless Feat, Stealth and Survival Skills
